general.autoStartHint: Start Lenz silently in the menu bar
general.checkUpdateHint: Poll GitHub Releases once a day
general.openOnLaunchHint: When off, stays in the menu bar only
general.proxyHint: Applies to cloud engines only — local requests bypass it

shortcuts.selectionHint: Translate the text selected at the cursor
shortcuts.screenshotHint: Select a region, OCR, then show the translation
shortcuts.overlayHint: Render the translation right over the original pixels
shortcuts.permissionNote: Word translation needs macOS Accessibility permission; overlay needs Screen Recording. Both are requested on first use.

engines.desc: Stack multiple engines and set a default. Local models keep every request on-device; cloud engines use your proxy settings.
engines.emptyDesc: Add a local engine like LM Studio or Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible / cloud service.

ocr.accuracyHint: “Accurate” is ~2× slower but handles small text
ocr.languagesDesc: Vision prioritizes these when auto-detecting. Drag to reorder.

about.stack: MIT License · Tauri 2.0 · Apple Vision OCR
about.privacy: Lenz runs entirely on your device. No data upload, no telemetry, no account. Translations via cloud engines (DeepSeek, Google Translate, etc.) are sent only to those providers.
